title: "10-amaliy mashg'ulot "
author: "Oxunboboyev Abdubannob"
date: "2026-11-10"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
# 1. Berilgan statistik toplam
x <- c(32, 30, 32, 31, 33, 5, 30, 32, 31, 32)

# 2. Sonlarni o'sish tartibida tartiblash
x_sorted <- sort(x)

cat("Tartiblangan toplam:\n")
print(x_sorted)

# Kuzatuvlar soni
n <- length(x_sorted)
cat("Kuzatuvlar soni:", n, "\n\n")

# 3. O'rtacha arifmetik (Mean)
mean_value <- mean(x_sorted)

cat("1. Mean =", mean_value, "\n")

# 4. Mediana (Median)
median_value <- median(x_sorted)

cat("2. Median =", median_value, "\n")

# 5. Moda (Mode)
mode_value <- as.numeric(
  names(which.max(table(x_sorted)))
)

cat("3. Mode =", mode_value, "\n")

# 6. Outlier (IQR usuli)
Q1 <- quantile(x_sorted, 0.25, type = 7)
Q3 <- quantile(x_sorted, 0.75, type = 7)

IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1

lower_limit <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_limit <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

outliers <- x_sorted[
  x_sorted < lower_limit | x_sorted > upper_limit
]

cat("4. Q1 =", Q1, "\n")
cat("   Q3 =", Q3, "\n")
cat("   IQR =", IQR_value, "\n")
cat("   Lower limit =", lower_limit, "\n")
cat("   Upper limit =", upper_limit, "\n")
cat("   Outlier =", outliers, "\n")

# 7. Dispersiya (Population Variance)
variance_value <- mean((x_sorted - mean_value)^2)

cat("5. Variance =", variance_value, "\n")

# 8. Standart og'ish (Population Standard Deviation)
sd_value <- sqrt(variance_value)

cat("6. Standard Deviation =", sd_value, "\n")

# 9. Barcha natijalarni jadvalda chiqarish
results <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Mean",
    "Median",
    "Mode",
    "Outlier",
    "Variance",
    "Standard Deviation"
  ),
  Result = c(
    mean_value,
    median_value,
    mode_value,
    ifelse(length(outliers) > 0, paste(outliers, collapse = ", "), NA),
    variance_value,
    sd_value
  )
)

cat("\nYAKUNIY NATIJALAR:\n")
print(results)
```
